name: Night Light for Gamma-less Displays
description:
Applies GNOME's Night Light color temperature to monitors whose driver has no gamma LUT (e.g. DisplayLink/evdi). Follows the built-in Night Light schedule and temperature exactly; monitors that support gamma are left alone.

Requires colord's GObject introspection data (installed by default on Fedora; on some distros it is a separate package such as gir1.2-colord-1.0).
